subject: Add newline to argv in crash report when doing redact (#993)
reason: The change only fixes log formatting in the crash report: it removes a trailing space and adds a missing newline to the serverLog lines printed for redacted argv entries in _serverAssertPrintClientInfo and logCurrentClient (src/debug.c). These functions run only inside the assertion/crash handlers, so the change has no effect on command replies, data, replication, or any behaviour an oracle can judge — it is a cosmetic logging change with no behaviour change, and needs no scenario.
